definitions.explanation: Ill feeling or harmful intent toward others. Most often heard in the negative {邪気|じゃき}のない, meaning innocent, guileless, and free of any bad intentions.

definitions.gloss: evil energy; noxious influence; evil spirit
definitions.explanation: An unseen harmful force or malignant spirit, as imagined in folk belief. Something to be warded off or driven away for good health and fortune.

examples.english: That child has no malice; she is completely innocent.

notes:
Two related senses: human ill will (sense 1) and unseen evil energy (sense 2). Sense 1 is by far the more common in everyday speech, almost always in {邪気|じゃき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {邪気|じゃき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: innocent; guileless
- {邪気|じゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to ward off evil
- {邪気|じゃき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}い{払|はら}う→追い払う：06347_oiharau⟧: to drive away evil spirits
